alerts.headline: APL Apollo Tubes stock: Brokerages slash price targets on debt, earnings concerns following Tata Steel deal
alerts.summary: Brokerages turned cautious on APL Apollo Tubes following the Tata Steel deal, citing higher leverage, earnings dilution and the promoter's exit. Revised price targets range from Rs 1,345 to Rs 1,459.
second_order_candidates: Winner: APL Apollo's selling promoter entity (cash out at a premium) and, longer term, Tata Steel's tubes/coated volumes once control passes; see [ccb535c2a4d8].

Losers: APL Apollo minority holders (APLAPOLLO): brokerages see higher debt and weaker earnings if the staged purchase leads to an open offer and a thinner float; Tata Steel (TATASTEEL) carries the funding. Peers (JINDALSAW, HITECH, SURYAROSNI) face a better-backed rival; inferred, not confirmed.
Catalyst: scheduled follow-up - remaining tranches and open-offer window, dates not read; target cuts are a reaction to news already in prices.
Thesis fit: none (no draft: offer terms and dates unverified, move already priced)
